body: This run uses frozen DINOv2 patch tokens and PCA residual scoring, then calibrates normalized scores from held-out normal validation images.
It is a local baseline inspired by SubspaceAD-style evidence, not a claim that the upstream SubspaceAD repository was executed.
research.tagline: 8 normal SEM support tiles define the normal subspace.
research.title: Frozen DINOv2 + PCA residual baseline

body: The recovered ZIP yielded 1,501 readable SEM JPEGs: 1,385 normal and 116 anomaly images. One truncated normal file was excluded.
Image-level labels are enough for AUROC/AUPR; pixel metrics are intentionally withheld because masks were not recovered.
research.tagline: The partial archive gives SEM proxy evidence but no aligned masks.
research.title: Recovered MIIC partial evidence
